# ReShade SDK

Official ReShade SDK headers from tag `v6.5.1`, API version 17.

Source: https://github.com/crosire/reshade/tree/v6.5.1/include

Fetched on 2026-09-19 for the locally installed ReShade 6.5.1. The original
headers and LICENSE.md are preserved. No ImGui dependency is used by this add-on.
